description: Add discoverability comments for orch_context_window, meta_loop, and worker_isolation in cam-cli's own scripts/cam/project.toml [loop] section.

userStories.title: Document [loop] keys with commented examples in project.toml
userStories.description: As an operator configuring cam-cli, I need the [loop] section of scripts/cam/project.toml to show the orch_context_window default and the accepted values for meta_loop and worker_isolation so that these knobs are discoverable from the config file without reading the source or ADRs.
acceptanceCriteria: The [loop] section of scripts/cam/project.toml carries a COMMENTED example line for orch_context_window showing the default value 200000 (e.g. `# orch_context_window = 200000`), matching DEFAULT_ORCH_CONTEXT_WINDOW at src/config/models.ts:329. [oracle: grep -E '^# *orch_context_window = 200000' scripts/cam/project.toml]

orch_context_window stays a commented example and is NOT added as an active uncommented key, so readOrchContextWindow (src/config/models.ts:347-362) continues to return the runtime default 200000 unchanged. [oracle: file-assert: no active `orch_context_window` key present -> grep -c -E '^[^#]*orch_context_window' scripts/cam/project.toml returns 0]

meta_loop keeps its existing active value `meta_loop = "auto"` and gains a short comment listing its accepted values auto | observe | off, consistent with readMetaLoop (src/config/models.ts:240). [oracle: grep -E '^meta_loop = "auto"' scripts/cam/project.toml && grep -qE 'auto \| observe \| off' scripts/cam/project.toml]

worker_isolation keeps its existing active value `worker_isolation = "host"` and gains a short comment listing its accepted values container | host, consistent with readWorkerIsolation (src/config/models.ts:305). [oracle: grep -E '^worker_isolation = "host"' scripts/cam/project.toml && grep -qE 'container \| host' scripts/cam/project.toml]

No change is made to cam init scaffolding or any file other than scripts/cam/project.toml (scaffold discoverability is out of scope, tracked in CAM-283). [oracle: file-assert: git diff --name-only lists only scripts/cam/project.toml plus scripts/cam/prd.json/handoff.json state files]
The file still parses and no effective config value changes. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single file: scripts/cam/project.toml (the [loop] section at lines 18-20). DIRECT hand-edit only. GOTCHA: the TOML serializer stringifyToml (src/config/toml.ts:68-96) cannot emit # comments, so never route this through mergeIntoConfig/stringifyToml (it would drop the comments). Keep orch_context_window COMMENTED (uncommenting pins the value and defeats the read-with-default path). Keep enums in sync with the real readers in src/config/models.ts (meta_loop: auto|observe|off; worker_isolation: container|host); do not invent values. Comments are valid in TOML input (only serialization drops them), so loadConfig still parses the file. No vendor/ or templates/ change (embed-vendor check not required). scripts/cam/patterns.md: grep 'config' / 'toml' if a config-edit gotcha is needed.
